newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee coop stocks total 3.21 million bags in Dec. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee coop stocks total 3.21 million bags in Dec. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]

text.p: Coffee stocks held by Brazilian cooperatives totaled 3.21 million 60.5 kg bags on Dec 31, National Coffee Council (CNC) said in a statement.

This is down from than the 3.68 million bags held by cooperatives as of Nov 30, but up from the 2.76 million bags held at the same stage in 1995 when producers were bringing in the frost and drought-hit 1995/96 harvest.
Sales by cooperatives reached 5.86 million bags between the beginning of May and the end of December.

This is well up from the 3.45 million bags sold in the same period in 1995 but also from the 4.32 million bags sold between May and end-December 1994, "proving that coffee producers are not excessively holding on to their coffee," according to the statement.
Cooperatives received 162,446 bags of coffee during the month of December, well over twice the 72,309 bags delivered in December the previous year.
